interface.longDescription: Connect LegalizaObra to chat to regularize the INSS of construction works in Brazil: register clients and obras, add pedreiros to each obra, simulate INSS costs, send obras to eSocial and generate each month's DARF. CPF and CNPJ never go through the chat: the user enters them in the app. Bundled skills teach the agent each workflow step by step.
defaultPrompt: Show me what I can do with my LegalizaObra account.
Simulate the INSS of a 120 m² house built in São Paulo.
Which of my obras still need this month's DARF?

name: legalizaobra
description: Regularize the INSS of construction works in Brazil: manage clients, obras and pedreiros, simulate INSS costs, send obras to eSocial and generate the monthly DARF.
